3436.d: Black Guards are unattackable dwarves doing special tasks for the Consortium, such as guarding the entrance to Barendir or repairing the machinery in the Lava-flow mine after they have been destroyed by the cloaked figure.

3442.ex: When you reach into the abyss, sometimes the abyss reaches back.
